entry.description: Operator demand: a 0.7.0 rc-3 aimed at documenting rand-engine so users, agents or humans, discover it, onboard and test features easily, with APIs and use cases well documented. Design direction: the API reference for every public method and option; use cases and recipes; executed doc examples; llms.txt and agent-facing docs; a quickstart. Builds on rc-1's FR7/FR8 docs and rc-2's features. The operator defines its scope after rc-2 closes; nothing beyond the quoted demand is scoped here.
entry.provenance: operator demand, /goal 2026-10-04 (main thread), verbatim: "ao final serei capaz de definir a rc3 que visará, ja registre isso, o objetivo de documentarmos o rand-engine da melhor forma possivel para que nossos usuários sejam eles agents ou humanos, possam descobrir a rand-engine facilmente, fazer onboarding facilmente e testar features. E tudo muito bem documentado, APIs, casos de uso. Para que nossos usuários possam usar a rand-engine da melhor forma"
entry.title: rc-3: documentation-first — discovery, onboarding and trying features for humans and AI agents
